title: Checkup result body
description: The result of a Clinic checkup (clinic.md CL-5; register row DK160; spec-delta S486). The Clinic orders a checkup (a clinic_order of kind checkup); a seed that neither side controls, made from the order and a record issued after it by someone other than the agent, picks the held-out variant of the suite; the agent runs it under the gateway; the Clinic re-scores the run itself and signs this record. It commits the agent's run-log hash (an Action of the agent), the pass rate per task on the agent's everyday work and on the held-out variant, and the flag the log recomputes: overfit when the held-out rate falls well below the everyday rate, clean when it does not, unmeasured when the run was only self-reported. Chain: none (prev is null).

seed_ref.description: A record issued after the order by someone other than the agent; the seed is the hash of the order id and this id.

variant.description: The held-out variant: the seed's place in the pool, as the log recomputes it.

run_log_hash.description: The agent's own Action the run rests on.

baseline.description: The earlier checkup result this is compared with.
